name: Say hello
task: Run this once. Change the message to something you choose and run it again.

name: Ask a name
task: Run it and type a pretend name. Explain where that name is remembered.

name: Change a number
task: Predict the result, run it, then change 2 to another small number.

name: Make a choice
code:
SET score 2
IF score > 1
    SAY "More than one"
ELSE
    SAY "One or less"
END
task: Optional: change score to 0. Predict which message appears.

name: Repeat
task: Optional: change how many times the message appears. Ask how to stop a stuck run.

name: Save a file
code:
WRITE FILE "practice.txt" WITH "My first file"
READ FILE "practice.txt" AS text
SAY text
task: Optional: use a new writable practice folder. Find the file after running it.
